title: Resident Evil
description: A delivery driver has to survive one nightmarish night as a deadly outbreak tears his city apart.

title: Runner
description: An ex-soldier and a talkative partner race cartel hitmen to get a life-saving organ to a sick child.

title: Street Fighter
description: Two former friends join a 1993 fighting tournament and find a sinister plot hidden behind it.

title: Practical Magic 2
description: The witch sisters of the Owens family fight an old curse that now endangers their daughters' love lives.

title: Other Mommy
description: A little girl befriends a malevolent presence in her house that has taken on her mother's face.

title: Mutiny
description: Blamed for his employer's killing, a man goes undercover on a freighter and finds a global conspiracy.

title: Whalefall
description: A young diver swallowed by a sperm whale has an hour of air to escape, guided by his late father's lessons.

title: Heart of the Beast
description: After a plane crash in Alaska, a soldier and his military dog fight to survive the frozen wilderness.

title: Digger
description: A tycoon scrambles to look like a hero while a disaster he caused spirals toward global catastrophe.

title: Avengers: Endgame
description: The surviving heroes regroup for one last attempt to reverse Thanos's destruction of half of all life.

title: Verity
description: A struggling writer hired to finish a famous author's books finds a disturbing secret manuscript in her home.

title: Sacrifice
description: A film star going through a personal crisis is taken hostage by a zealous cult at a glamorous charity gala.
